name: poki
tagline: Control iPhone apps and system functions via iMessage, Telegram, or terminal
description: Poki is an autonomous iPhone agent that can run tasks on a real iPhone. It reads the device’s accessibility tree, lets a language model decide actions, and sends native touch and input events. Verified runs are compiled into reusable routes that speed up similar tasks. Users connect their iPhone to a Mac, sign in with a model account, and send commands through iMessage, Telegram, a terminal CLI, or the Poki iOS app. Poki integrates with Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients, allowing developers to incorporate iPhone control into existing workflows.
best_for: Integrating iPhone control into developer pipelines
Running agents via iMessage or Telegram
Testing iOS apps on a physical device
Creating self‑learning routes for frequent tasks
